title: Sharper type roles and brighter welcome page
items: Each kind of text now has one font everywhere: condensed caps for headers, a monospace face for labels and data, Inter for body copy.
The welcome page is brighter: a white wordmark with a green M, a solid green Enter button, and lighter secondary text.
Home uses the same roles: condensed page title and headline numbers, monospace labels and 'View' links, and tighter corners.
